mr_title: Complete refactoring to move empty-String-defaulting out of (Std)ValueInstantiator

expected_issues.title: Non-empty string no longer reaches handleNonArray (single value as array breaks)
expected_issues.description:
Every String token is now routed to _deserializeFromString, so a non-empty scalar string no longer reaches handleNonArray and ACCEPT_SINGLE_VALUE_AS_ARRAY stops working for collections.

Previously only the empty String was special-cased and any other string fell through to handleNonArray(), which wraps a single value into a collection when ACCEPT_SINGLE_VALUE_AS_ARRAY is enabled. After the refactoring, `"abc"` for a List<Object> handled by CollectionDeserializer goes to _deserializeFromString(), which cannot build a Collection from a String and fails. Only the empty-string coercion path should be delegated; other strings must continue to handleNonArray().
